text:
mike: quick sync —incoming customer asks for an "optimize playbook" feature that can suggest batching, caching, and quantization profiles per-route, and to trigger eval-based alerts when quality regresses. they want an initial pilot in 8 weeks. thoughts?
anya: rough idea ok. need to scope MVP: recommendations vs automated changes. customer expects recommendations first, right?
ravi: yep recommend-only for pilot. automation later. main engineering risk is KV cache state migration + per-tenant prefix caching policy.
jordan: also must define what 'eval-triggered alert' means. is this token-level quality loss, metric drift on rouge/bertscore, or user-level regression?
mike: customer said A/B test on prompt-set evals and then alert if delta > threshold. prioritize signal-to-noise: false positives kill trust.
priya: propose launch criteria: (1) recommender suggests batching configs and quant profiles per model/route; (2) UI + API to accept/reject suggestions; (3) eval webhook that ingests periodic eval runs and fires alerts when user-configured rules trip; (4) basic telemetry for cost delta and latency impact.
anya: tech tasks I'd call out: instrumentation hook for request histograms by route+sequence-length, offline analyzer to propose batch sizes and cache TTLs, quantization profile builder that outputs candidate qparams and validated fast-paths.
ravi: implementation notes: continuous batching suggestions need histograms for p95 seq len and request per-second. suggest binning seq len into [0-64,65-256,257-1024] and computing util per bin.
mike: ok. metrics we track for success: cost per 1M tokens, median latency, recommendation adoption rate, eval-regression rate after rollout. target adoption 30% in pilot customers.
jordan: alerting semantics: allow two rule types: absolute threshold (e.g., delta > 0.03 BERTScore) and percentage drop vs baseline. include debounce window and min-samples. sample rule format:```
rule: {
  route: "/api/generate",
  metric: "bert_score",
  comparator: "relative",
  baseline: "canary-2026-05",
  threshold: 0.03,
  min_evals: 10,
  debounce_minutes: 60
}
```
mike: perfect. who owns eval infra ingestion? @anya?
anya: i'll take ingestion + rule matcher. need help from telemetry team to ensure eval runs are tagged with route/model/version.
priya: UX: minimal modal flow to accept suggestion + quick rollback. must show estimated cost delta and expected latency impact. show short explanation: "increase batch to 8 for seq<64 reduces cost by ~18% at p99 latency +12ms"
ravi: note quantization recommendations need offline validation. we should include a safety net: generate two quantized variants, run end-to-end checks on short prompts, compare logits distribution and sampled outputs for hallucination spikes. if mismatch > tolerance, mark as "unsafe".
mike: deployment plan: feature-flagged, start internal canary -> opt-in pilot tenants -> public beta. rollout gates: pass safety checks, <2% eval-regressions on pilot, and infra cost delta within budget.
jordan: data retention: eval histories could get large. suggest default retention 90 days and ability to archive.
anya: ops notes: evaluate storage by events-per-eval * avg-eval-size. rough calc: 100 customers * 10 evals/day * 100KB = ~100MB/day -> fine. but needs index for quick rule eval.
priya: any security/compliance asks? customers want PII scrubber for sample prompts in eval reports. add opt-out and SCRUB pipeline.
mike: timeline: week 1: design + telemetry instrument; week 2-4: backend recommender + eval ingestion; week 5: quant offline validation; week 6: UI + rule editor; week 7: internal canary; week 8: pilot kickoff. is that realistic?
ravi: aggressive but doable if we scope MVP tightly and reuse existing batching infra. remove automatic profile generation for more complex model families from MVP.
anya: agree. MVP: heuristics-based batching suggestions, simple TTL caching recommendations, quant suggestions only for small models (<=13B) with 8-bit candidates. advanced continuous tuning later.
mike: deliverables for pilot: API to list suggestions, POST to accept, eval webhook, rule editor, telemetry dashboard with cost/latency/eval charts.
jordan: logging: every suggestion should include rationale + supporting stats. store as JSON blob for audit.
priya: customer comms: communicate pilot as "recommendations only" + manual acceptance and rollback. surface expected ops tasks and privacy protections.
mike: blockers?
anya: need one telemetry engineer for 2 weeks and eng-ml for quant validation for 3 weeks.
ravi: dependency on model catalog metadata (sequence length distributions) — get product to gate customers who have model metadata available.
mike: ok. action items: @anya write ticket for eval ingestion + rule matcher (due EOW), @ravi scope quant validation tasks, @priya mock up rule editor flow. i'll draft pilot invite email.
deploy-bot: Deployed feature-flag scaffold to staging (ff: optimize_playbook_recs).
mike: thanks all. will sync Fri to lock timeline. :thumbsup:
